analysis:
The only change in this PR is documentation in docs/provider/cli-reference.md, head lines 986-991. It adds a `darkbloom status` bullet describing a runtime-integrity line. That line appears when the coordinator's latest `runtime_status` marked the provider's runtime hashes outdated. It reports the mismatch count, says the provider is excluded from routing, and gives the fix `darkbloom update`. The doc also says the line clears itself once the record is more than 15 minutes old, because the coordinator only re-sends `verified:false` while the mismatch lasts.

The PR contains no code, so no authorization, encryption, attestation or data-exposure controls change. The text describes a read-only, user-facing status display of coordinator-sent information. It exposes no secrets, and it does not alter the TB-002 trust assumptions (coordinator trusted, providers adversarial) or the TB-009/TB-011 evidence paths.

One point for later review: the status line is derived from coordinator-sent `runtime_status` and a staleness timeout. It is informational and is not an authorization input, so a stale, missing or spoofed message cannot grant serving. The claim that the provider is excluded from routing is a coordinator-owned backend behavior. It is outside the supplied evidence and outside this repository, so I did not verify it. The rest of the file (graceful stop, logout, autopilot, doctor and other sections) is unchanged context. It restates existing behavior in line with TB-011 and A-008, and I identified no regression there.
